text.description_html:
Emtek 76028, San Carlos 8 Inch Wrought Steel Door Handle

The 8 Inch San Carlos Door Pull looks like it came straight from the old world. This castle style door pull is made out of wrought steel and is available in either a flat black steel or satin steel finish. Both of these finish colors have a rough texture for a truly rustic end look--a look that would be at home on any period style door. The San Carlos 8 Inch Wrought Steel Door Handle comes packaged with the necessary mounting hardware to thru-bolt it on a door up to 1-3/4 inches thick.

Thru-Bolted Mounting: Pull bolts through the door.

Also Available: San Carlos Pull with Back-to-Back Mounting

Specifications of the Emtek San Carlos Wrought Steel Pull:

  • Material: Wrought Steel
  • Total Length: 12-1/4"
  • Center to Center Length: 8"
  • Pull Handle Width: 1-1/16"
  • Total Projection: 2-7/16"
  • Mount Height: 2-1/4"
  • Mount Width: 1-1/8"
  • Door Thickness: for doors up to 1-3/4" thick
  • Includes installation hardware required for fiberglass, wood, and metal doors.
  • Comes packaged with (2) 1" long 1/4"-20 screws, (2) 1" long #10-32 screws, (2) 2" #10-32 screws, and (2) screw caps.

Sold individually with thru-bolt mounting.
